title: The Names on the Stones
html:
Halden's ledger and the crypt disagree about how many are buried under the hill. He wants the brass plates off the coffins to settle it.

About

Given byHalden Rooke
Level7
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points2

What you need

  • Coffin Plate ×10

Steps

  1. Talk to Halden Rooke (outdoors near Binx Crypt) to get the quest.
  2. Take 10 coffin plates from the crypt skeletons for Halden (10) - Coffin Plate at 71, 88
  3. Give Halden Rooke your answer at 71, 88

Rewards

Reward
Gold280
Character XP6,300
Quest points2

What Halden Rooke says

Halden Rooke: Ten plates. Four of these names aren't in the book at all, and one of them I buried myself, thirty years back, under a different name entirely.

Halden Rooke: So. Before I work out what that means, what do you want done with it? Once I say it out loud to somebody official, it stops being mine to handle.

Halden Rooke: Suppose that's right. Suppose I've been keeping a book about a thing that stopped being about books a while back. I'll send word up the hill. They'll do nothing for a month and then they'll do something stupid, but I'll have sent it.

Halden Rooke: That's the last of them, then.

Halden Rooke: Thirty years I've kept that book straight. Now I've to go back through it and put a line under my own handwriting.

You: Do you want a hand with it?

Halden Rooke: No. Go on, then. I've a book to correct, and I'd rather do that on my own.

Handing it in

"I've a book to correct, and I'd rather do that on my own."
